acip: 'JAM DPAL LEGS SO, ,LEGS SO, ,'JAM DPAL, KHYOD SNYING RJE DANG LDAN PA STE, 'JAM DPAL, KHYOD KYIS SNYING RJE DPAG TU MED PA BSKYED NAS SEMS CAN THAMS CAD KYI DON DANG, SEMS CAN LAS KYI SGRIB PA SNA TSOGS KYIS BSGRIBS PA, NAD SNA TSOGS KYIS LUS YONGS SU GZIR BA, MYA NGAN DANG, SDUG BSNGAL SNA TSOGS KYIS GTZES PA'I LHA DANG, MI RNAMS KYI DON DANG, PHAN PA DANG, BDE BA'I PHYIR GSOL BA 'DEBS PA NI YANG LEGS SO,,
wylie: 'jam dpal legs so, ,legs so, ,'jam dpal, khyod snying rje dang ldan pa ste, 'jam dpal, khyod kyis snying rje dpag tu med pa bskyed nas sems can thams cad kyi don dang, sems can las kyi sgrib pa sna tshogs kyis bsgribs pa, nad sna tshogs kyis lus yongs su gzir ba, mya ngan dang, sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gtses pa'i lha dang, mi rnams kyi don dang, phan pa dang, bde ba'i phyir gsol ba 'debs pa ni yang legs so
english: It is good, Gentle Voice—it is good.  You are truly a person with a heart of compassion.  You have made this request out of thoughts of compassion which are too great even to imagine.  You have spoken for the sake of every living being of the universe—for beings who face a wide range of different karmic obstacles; for beings whose bodies are threatened by a whole range of terrible diseases; for those who are plagued by an entire range of different sufferings.  You have made your request for the sake of both gods and humans; to help them, and bring them happiness.  And so—it is good.
